packages.title: 2D water effect

packages.author: Trung Le (Kagamma)

packages.title: Castle Bars
packages.description: Several basic bars (horizontal, vertical and circular progressbars) and sliders (horizontal, vertical and continuous, discrete).
packages.author: Eugene Loza

packages.title: cge-2d-particle-emitter
packages.description:
2D particle system using "71 Squared" format (.pex files). Particles are calculated on CPU or with GPU acceleration (transform feedback).
This is deprecated now in favor of cge-3d-particle-emitter.
packages.author: Trung Le (Kagamma)

packages.title: Effekseer Integration
packages.description: Integration with Effekseer, a full-featured open-source particle effect creation tool.
packages.author: Trung Le (Kagamma)

packages.title: xistext-Icosphere
packages.description: Create icosphere (alternative way to triangulate a sphere, that doesn't have poles).
packages.author: Erik Johnson

packages.title: Particle Emitter
packages.description: Particle system for 3D and 2D that supports editing right inside CGE editor. Particles are calculated with GPU acceleration (transform feedback).
packages.author: Trung Le (Kagamma)

packages.title: Shifted Image Control
packages.description:
TCastleShiftedImageControl that can render cropped images with a shift. Also comes with two utilities:

- ShiftedConvert - crops transparent parts of the image and converts it into a shifted image, that is rendered by TCastleShiftedImageControl.
- AlphaBleeder - slower but more "beautiful" version of TCastleImage.AlphaBleed

This may come in handy when rendering multiple images that should be aligned properly to each other but have large unused transparent areas (e.g. different exported layers from InkScape). Should boost RAM/VRAM usage and performance a bit.
packages.author: Eugene Loza

packages.title: Spine Runtime for Castle Game Engine
packages.description: Render Spine models using official Spine runtime, that supports more Spine features than built-in CGE support.
packages.author: Trung Le (Kagamma)

packages.title: Typing Label
packages.description: A label (child of TCastleLabel) that supports "typing effect" on the text (text apppears gradually, one letter at a time). Allows skipping and restarting typing. Supports HTML rich text.
packages.author: Eugene Loza

packages.title: UI Shaker
packages.description: A child of TCastleUserInterface that shakes all its children when asked to.
packages.author: Eugene Loza
